issue: सुरभूप: a list 'gods and kings' (beside ज्ञानी विज्ञानी) or 'the king of the gods' (Indra).
our reading: Gods and kings, the wise and the realised serve his feet.

issue: विनवत श्यामा हमेश: श्यामा may be the poet's name (a signature) or Lakṣmī; the plain reading keeps the name.
our reading: Śyāmā prays always, with both hands joined.
